dataset: JHU IACL full retinal layer dataset, healthy control hc01, right eye
citation: Y. He, A. Carass, S.D. Solomon, S. Saidha, P.A. Calabresi, J.L. Prince. Retinal layer parcellation of optical coherence tomography images: Data resource for Multiple Sclerosis and Healthy Controls. Data in Brief 22 (2019), 601-604. DOI: 10.1016/j.dib.2018.12.073.

annotation_reference.selection: OCTMatTool/Preprocess/Preprocess.m removes empty one-based boundary slots 3 and 11
annotation_reference.interpolation: Sort and deduplicate lateral controls, source unit-parameter natural cubic spline, nearest endpoint extrapolation, and clamp successive boundaries against crossing.
annotation_reference.rasterization: Round one-based depth boundaries; each layer occupies upper+1 through lower inclusive.
annotation_reference.coverage: All 49 B-scans contain nine manually delineated boundaries. The eight layers are inferred between adjacent source boundaries.

layers.name: GCL+IPL
layers.description: Ganglion cell and inner plexiform layers

conversion.lateral_sampling: Retain native lateral indices 0,2,...,1022; native index 1023 is omitted. ScaleX is doubled.
conversion.slow_sampling: Linearly resample transformed intensities and unrounded boundaries from per-B-scan physical positions to 49 evenly spaced positions across 6.149238953366875 mm. Native adjacent pitches range from 0.12010203066263614 to 0.13211284885730468 mm.
conversion.axial_sampling: Native depth samples and ScaleZ are preserved; thickness is occupied depth voxels multiplied by 3.867251332849264 microns.
conversion.coordinates: Shared local zero origin, identity direction, and millimetre spacing for image and segmentation. Patient anatomical orientation is not inferred.
conversion.intensities: Nested float32 square roots of source reflectivity before slow-axis interpolation. This is a display transform, not unmodified linear reflectivity.
conversion.missing_reflectivity: Non-finite or out-of-range native values are missing. A resampled voxel is valid only when every source with nonzero interpolation weight is valid. Missing output intensity is zero.
conversion.missing_annotations: An entire retinal column is excluded from all eight labels when any expected retinal voxel lacks valid intensity. 22 of 25088 output columns are excluded; 25066 have complete retinal coverage.
conversion.limitations: Without the optional validity image, genuine zero reflectivity and missing intensity are indistinguishable. Zero-filled missing samples contribute to mean and sum projections. Missing labels are zero, so the image/segmentation pair alone cannot distinguish anatomical absence from excluded coverage. Thickness is quantized to the native axial voxel pitch and inherits manual-boundary and slow-axis interpolation uncertainty.
conversion.bundle: jhu-retinal-layers.zip contains only jhu-hc01.nrrd and jhu-hc01.seg.nrrd. No layout, session, manifest, or runtime configuration. Optional validity and conversion reports remain outside the ZIP.
conversion.patient_metadata: No patient or visit header fields are exported.
conversion.loading: Load the ZIP from the Retinal OCT layers sample, disk, or URL parameters. The default seg filename convention selects jhu-hc01.nrrd as the base image and associates jhu-hc01.seg.nrrd as its segmentation. Select the En face view and use the default Coronal projection axis for this non-DICOM OCT; physical calibration is already present in the NRRD.

reference_outputs.checksum_note: NRRD and ZIP hashes identify the reference outputs, verified against the hosted derivative archive. Voxel-payload hashes avoid differences in gzip implementation across runtimes.
